title: MediaROMancer: DA: Daisuke Asakura
overview:
mediaROMancer DA is a music multimedia disc devoted to Japanese musician and producer Daisuke Asakura. It is not a game, but an interactive collection built around his music, with a discography, interview clips and a look at the equipment in his studio, along with private video footage shot in Mexico.

There is also a light whack-a-mole style minigame: Asakura's manager has been kidnapped, and hitting the required number of targets sets him free. Runs on the Sega Saturn alone, with no Photo CD or other add-ons needed.
